verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing lists integrations with external CI systems (Drone, Woodpecker, Jenkins), and community users report running Gitea with Drone for years. None of the evidence says those builds appear as status checks on commits or pull requests. The generic API/webhooks claim is only a building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented commit status API, status checks shown on PRs/commits, required-status-check branch protection, hands-on confirmation of external CI status reporting.
